# How much of your QSBS gain is excluded?

> Free calculator for the Section 1202 Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) gain exclusion, expanded by OBBBA — compares the old all-or-nothing 5-year rule against the new tiered 3/4/5-year schedule for stock acquired after July 4, 2025, and the higher $15M exclusion cap. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
